op.description: add = new entry; rm = remove an entry by name; ls = list all entries

name.description: add, rm: the entry's name (one word, like check-inbox)

every.description: add: send every this many cycles (a positive integer); the entry stays

after.description: add: send once, this many cycles from now (a positive integer); then the entry removes itself

at.description: add: send once at this wall-clock time, local time: HH:MM (today, or tomorrow if past), YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or +N with s, m, h or d (like +10m); then the entry removes itself

cron.description: add: send at wall-clock times by a 5-field cron expression, local time: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (like "*/15 * * * *" or "0 9 * * 1"); the entry stays

text.description: add: the text of every letter

box.description: add: a mailbox folder (like an agent's STACK/queue); leave it out = your own queue

replace.description: add: true = replace an entry with the same name

daemon.description: a daemon's stack folder: use its clock (default: the clock you live under)
